1. RUN git fetch origin main
   IF it fails because there is no `origin`: RUN git merge-base main HEAD
   IF it fails for any other reason: continue with the `origin/main` I already have
2. RUN git merge-base origin/main HEAD
3. RUN git rev-parse HEAD
4. RUN git diff --name-only --diff-filter=AR <BASE>..HEAD -- ':/specs/plans/completed/'
   IF it prints nothing: go to action 5
   IF it prints a path: this is a plan branch, so dispatch the explainer subagent with `Plan branch: yes`, ask no question, then report the path and word count and go to Step 4
5. ASK This branch adds no plan. Do you want an explainer of it before the menu?
   IF yes: dispatch the explainer subagent with `Plan branch: no`, report `Explainer (<N> words): <path>`, then go to Step 4
   IF no: go to Step 4
